# Banner

Atlas status banner. Untyped legacy JavaScript — no prop contract at all; `tone` is one of info | danger | warning | success by convention only.

Import: `import { Banner } from '@ds/react';` — the only public entry point.

Static component (no react-aria-components base) — plain semantic HTML.
